chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar from Safwan from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who said:

A child was born to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) in Mina, so he sent to us on the Day of Sacrifice (Nahr) khabis (a type of bread) with saffron, and we had already shaved [our heads]. Abd al-Rahman said: 'I ate, and Abu al-Kahili and Murazm said they would eat from it, and they said: We have not yet visited the House (performed Tawaf). Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) heard our speech and said to Musaffa, who was the messenger who brought it to us: 'In what matter were they speaking?' He said: 'Abd al-Rahman ate, and the other two said they had not yet visited [the House].' He said: 'Abd al-Rahman was correct.' Then he said: 'Do you not remember when it was brought to us on a day like this, and I ate from it, and my brother Abu Abdillah said he would eat from it? When my father came, he urged him upon me, and I said: O father, indeed Musa ate khabis with saffron and had not yet visited [the House].' My father said: 'He is more learned than you. Have you not shaved your heads?'

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ع: Abu al-Hasan (Imam al-Rida, peace be upon him)
key_terms.خَبِيص: A type of bread or cake, often with saffron
key_terms.طَوَافَ الزِّيَارَةِ: Tawaf al-Ziyarah (the principal circumambulation of Hajj)
key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating food after shaving the head but before performing Tawaf al-Ziyarah during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Istibsar* illustrates the practical application of Hajj jurisprudence, specifically the ruling that shaving the head before Tawaf al-Ziyarah lifts most prohibitions (except for women and perfume). The Imam’s reference to Musa (AS) serves as a rational precedent (*qiyas*) to validate the permissibility of eating, demonstrating the Shia emphasis on logical deduction in fiqh. It highlights the flexibility in Hajj rites, allowing pilgrims to proceed with daily activities once the head is shaved, regardless of the order of Tawaf.
